B=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in out.split('\n')])

from scipy import ndimage
for c in range(10):
    m = A==c
    if c in (0,5) or not m.any(): continue
    lab,n = ndimage.label(m, structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    print('color',c,'cells',m.sum(),'components',n)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ys,xs = np.where(lab==i)
        print('  comp',i,'size',len(ys),'cells',sorted(zip(ys.tolist(),xs.tolist())))
print('B pixels:')
ys,xs=np.where(B!=0)
for y,x in zip(ys,xs): print((y,x),B[y,x])
